docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,933.72 FILED BY SKLANSKY, ALLYN D. AS TO DEFENDANT OTT, SABRINA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-09-2004 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
